balance_policy.name: integer-half-gains-double-losses
balance_policy.baseline: The proposal fields below remain the original narrative values
balance_policy.no_loss_gains: If both baseline deltas are nonnegative, divide positive deltas by 2 with integer rounding down
balance_policy.tradeoffs: Retain positive gains when either baseline delta is negative
balance_policy.losses: Original -30 story deltas become -40; multiply other negative story deltas by 2
balance_policy.deferred_effects: Classify the full story pair before postponing its discovered loss
balance_policy.statistics: Halve accumulated KO gains with rounding down; double losses; independent caps become +7 and -60
balance_policy.exceptions: Keep initial scores 75/75 and emergency recovery +25; never rescale existing state or effective-credit reversals
